name: mysterymaps: Geographic Mapping Tools for Healthcare Access Studies
description: Builds the maps healthcare access and mystery-caller studies keep needing: county choropleths of provider supply, dissolved drive-time coverage surfaces layered as mutually exclusive alternatives, provider dot maps that stay clickable, and the legend, label and notes furniture those require. A single template assembles the common case; the pieces are exported for maps that are not. Also covers isochrone generation via the HERE Routing API, block-group overlap, Hospital Referral Region and ACOG district overlays, and state choropleths. Defaults encode cartographic decisions that are easy to get wrong: zero is its own colour class rather than the bottom of a gradient, legends follow the active base layer, and saved widgets stay self-contained.
